module: Module 6: Independent Sub-Account Margin, Leverage & Stop-Outs
title: Maximum Leverage Limit on Master Terminal Sizing
precondition: Manager attempts order that would push lowest-leverage sub-account past 1:30 limit.
expected: Order clamped or blocked: 'Order exceeds maximum leverage limit for retail sub-accounts in group'.
coverage_note: Requires configured stop-out/leverage/news/swap/notification fixtures beyond the verified account margin cases.
